exposure: Participation in non-CrossFit group fitness classes
cohort: The cohort consisted of 423 women participating in either CrossFit (322) or non-CrossFit group fitness classes (101).
finding: CrossFit participants reported a significantly higher prevalence (84% vs 48%) and severity of urinary incontinence, including stress UI, compared to women participating in non-CrossFit group fitness classes.
cross-section timing: During participation in CrossFit or non-CrossFit group fitness classes, assessing current UI status.
